seriesTitle: Miniature Diaphragm Solenoid Valves for Liquid On/Off Control and Flow-Path Switching
seriesDescription: FOREACH SV10 miniature diaphragm solenoid valves control reagent and wash-fluid lines in analytical instruments and automated liquid-handling equipment. Choose 2-way normally closed or normally open operation for on/off control, or a 3-way valve for switching a shared line between two fluid paths.
seriesIntegration: Choose manifold mounting for direct integration on a fluidic block, barbed ports for flexible tubing, or M6 or 1/4-28 UNF threaded ports for connections through fittings. Check the mounting face, tubing arrangement and service access against the instrument layout.
seriesCompare: Choose 2-way on/off control or 3-way switching first. For a 2-way valve, select normally closed or normally open, then match the connections, wetted materials and voltage to your equipment.
seriesSeo: FOREACH SV10 miniature diaphragm solenoid valves for reagent and wash lines. Compare 2-way and 3-way configurations, manifold, barbed and threaded ports.

detailIntro.nc: The SV10 normally closed 2-way valve controls reagent or wash-fluid lines that must close when power is removed. It opens when energized, working with the pump and instrument sequence to control delivery. The valve opens or closes the fluid path; a pump or pressure difference moves the liquid.
detailIntro.no: The SV10 normally open 2-way valve keeps a reagent or wash-fluid line open when power is removed and closes it when energized, allowing the instrument to interrupt delivery as needed. The valve opens or closes the fluid path; a pump or pressure difference moves the liquid.
detailIntro.three: The SV10 3-way valve switches a common port between two other ports so that a shared line can connect to either reagent or wash fluid. Coordinate switching with the pump and instrument sequence for delivery and rinsing, and check the energized and de-energized connections against the fluid circuit.
detailIntro.two: The SV10 2-way valve opens or closes a reagent or wash-fluid line. Choose normally closed operation if the line must close without power, or normally open operation if it must remain open; energizing the valve reverses that state. Coordinate the valve with the pump and instrument sequence to control delivery.

3-way-base: The SV10-P-3 is a miniature 2-position, 3-way diaphragm solenoid valve with a rocker diaphragm design. Its compact internal structure and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid. Switching the common port between the other two ports provides precise flow-path control for reagent supply and wash-fluid switching in automated sampling equipment, medical analytical instruments and laboratory liquid-handling systems.

The manifold-mount design and PEEK base plate allow multiple valves to be integrated on one fluidic manifold, bringing reagent branches and wash channels together. EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings can be selected for the reagents and wash fluids. When supply and washing share a line, use the actual internal volumes of the valve and tubing to assess system hold-up volume and determine the required wash-fluid volume.
3-way-barbed: The SV10-B16-3 is a micro diaphragm solenoid valve for 3-way liquid switching. Its compact rocker design and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid while providing precise control of the fluid path. Two ports connect to separate liquid sources, with the common port serving a shared line. Used with a pump, this tubing-type valve coordinates reagent delivery and rinsing in medical analyzers and laboratory instruments.

The barbed ports are recommended for flexible tubing with a 1.5–2.0 mm internal diameter, making it convenient to connect pumps, reservoirs and detection modules positioned throughout the instrument. Account for the shared line's hold-up volume when planning fluid changes and washing. EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings are available. Check tubing dimensions, hardness and compatibility with the fluids being handled.
3-way-threaded: The SV10-M6/U28-3 miniature 3-way diaphragm solenoid valve combines a rocker diaphragm design with threaded connections. Its compact internal structure and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid and support precise flow-path switching. Alternately connecting the common port to the other two ports lets one supply line carry reagent or wash fluid, supporting programmed dispensing, rinsing and fluid routing in analytical instruments.

M6 or 1/4-28 UNF ports connect to instrument tubing through matching fittings. When assessing residual liquid after a fluid change, consider the internal volumes of the valve, fittings and connected tubing together. EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings are available. Select the threaded valve-seat material for the fluid and check both the fitting thread specification and sealing method.
2-way-nc-base: The SV10-P-2NC is a base-mounted micro diaphragm solenoid valve with 2-position, 2-way normally closed operation. Its compact rocker design and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid and provide precise on/off control. Closed when de-energized and open when energized, it suits reagent, sampling and wash branches opened intermittently by the instrument program. It works with a pump to supply selected channels in automated analyzers and multi-reagent fluidic modules.

The manifold-mount design and PEEK base plate allow multiple 2-way valves to be arranged on a fluidic manifold. Each valve can serve a separate reagent branch; lay out the internal channels accordingly and check mounting holes and seal locations against the dimensional drawing. EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings can be selected separately for the reagents and wash fluids used in each branch.
2-way-nc-barbed: The SV10-B16-2NC miniature 2-way normally closed diaphragm solenoid valve combines a rocker diaphragm design with barbed tubing connections. Its compact internal structure and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid and provide precise on/off control. It opens when energized and closes when de-energized, allowing the instrument program to control when reagent, wash and sampling lines open. Weighing 29 g, it is suitable for individual valve positions inside the equipment.

Use flexible tubing with a 1.5–2.0 mm internal diameter, a hardness of 55–65 Shore A and an outer diameter below 4.5 mm. Leave space for inserting, bending and replacing the tubing. EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings are available. Select both tubing and valve seals for compatibility with the liquids delivered during normal operation and those used during cleaning.
2-way-nc-threaded: The SV10-M6/U28-2NC is a threaded micro diaphragm solenoid valve for 2-way liquid on/off control. Its compact rocker design and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid and provide precise control of the connection. It closes when de-energized and opens when energized, working with the pump and instrument program for reagent supply, sampling and rinsing in analytical instruments with threaded tube fittings.

M6 or 1/4-28 UNF ports allow the valve to match an existing tubing connection scheme. Select EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings according to reagent composition, concentration and operating temperature. During integration, check the valve-seat material, fitting seal design and tubing dimensions together so that the wetted materials and sealing arrangements are compatible throughout the branch.
2-way-no-base: The SV10-P-2NO miniature 2-way normally open diaphragm solenoid valve uses a rocker diaphragm design. Its compact internal structure and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid and provide precise on/off control. It remains open when de-energized and closes when energized, suiting liquid branches that normally stay open and close only during selected process steps. Use this operating state to plan the control sequence for supply or wash lines that remain open for extended periods.

The manifold-mount design and PEEK base plate support integration into a fluid-control module. Consider the manifold channels when assessing module hold-up volume and washing requirements. EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings are available. Define the fluid-path state during shutdown or loss of power, and assess whether liquid can continue to flow based on reservoir position, the pump and pressure differences in the circuit.
2-way-no-barbed: The SV10-B16-2NO is a normally open micro diaphragm solenoid valve with 2-way operation and barbed tubing ports. Its compact rocker design and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid and provide precise on/off control. The valve opens when de-energized and closes when energized, suiting supply or wash branches that normally remain open and are temporarily closed by the program in laboratory instruments and automated liquid-handling equipment.

The barbed ports are recommended for flexible tubing with a 1.5–2.0 mm internal diameter, allowing tubing to be routed around pumps, detection modules and reservoirs. Plan the mounting position around tubing bend space and maintenance access; a custom bracket can be provided as needed. Select EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings with both the delivered liquids and the cleaning fluids in mind.
2-way-no-threaded: The SV10-M6/U28-2NO miniature 2-way normally open diaphragm solenoid valve combines a rocker diaphragm design with threaded ports. Its compact internal structure and low dead volume help reduce retained liquid and provide precise on/off control. Energizing the valve closes the selected branch; removing power opens it again. This suits sampling, reagent delivery and line-washing sequences that require temporary interruptions to the liquid supply.

Choose M6 or 1/4-28 UNF ports to match the instrument's tube fittings. Include the valve, fitting and tubing volumes when assessing fluid changes and washing requirements. EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings are available. Check wetted-material compatibility together with the selected valve-seat material to meet the connection and sealing requirements of each reagent line.

detailMaterials.base: Select EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings after checking compatibility with the reagent and wash-fluid composition, concentration, temperature and contact time.
detailMaterials.barbed: This configuration has a PEEK base plate, with EPDM, FKM or FFKM options for the diaphragm and matching O-rings. Check material compatibility against the reagent and wash-fluid composition, concentration, temperature and contact time.
detailMaterials.threaded: EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings can be combined with the available valve-seat materials. Check all wetted parts against the actual reagents and wash fluids; a PFA seat or base plate requires separate configuration confirmation.

base.heading: Miniature Solenoid Valve for Manifold Mounting
base.definition: FOREACH SV10-P is a miniature diaphragm solenoid valve for mounting directly onto a fluidic manifold. Part of the SV10 series, it offers 2-way normally closed, 2-way normally open and 3-way versions for reagent supply and wash-fluid switching in automated equipment.
base.installation: The PEEK base plate seals against the mating manifold. Match the port layout, locating holes and seals to the selected 2-way or 3-way version before designing the mounting face.
base.seo: SV10-P miniature solenoid valve for manifold mounting. Choose 2-way NC/NO or 3-way and diaphragm materials for reagent and wash circuits.

threaded.heading: Miniature Solenoid Valve with M6 or 1/4-28 UNF Ports
threaded.definition: FOREACH SV10-M6 and SV10-U28 are miniature diaphragm solenoid valves with threaded ports for tube fittings. These SV10 series valves offer 2-way normally closed, 2-way normally open and 3-way versions for opening reagent lines or switching between reagent and wash fluid.
threaded.installation: Choose M6 or 1/4-28 UNF fittings to match the valve. Recommended thread engagement is 5 mm and tightening torque is 0.25–0.3 N·m. Use a suitable sealing washer at the bottom seal.
threaded.seo: SV10-M6 and SV10-U28 miniature solenoid valves with M6 or 1/4-28 UNF ports. Compare 2-way NC/NO and 3-way versions for reagent and wash-fluid connections.

barbed.descriptor: Miniature Solenoid Valve with Barbed Ports
barbed.heading: Miniature Solenoid Valve with Barbed Ports for Flexible Tubing
barbed.definition: FOREACH SV10-B16 is a miniature diaphragm solenoid valve with barbed ports for flexible tubing. Part of the SV10 series, it offers 2-way normally closed, 2-way normally open and 3-way versions for reagent on/off control and wash-fluid switching.
barbed.installation: Use flexible tubing with an internal diameter of 1.5–2.0 mm, hardness of 55–65 Shore A and outer diameter below 4.5 mm. A custom mounting bracket is available for integration into the equipment.
barbed.seo: SV10-B16 miniature solenoid valve with barbed ports for 1.5–2.0 mm ID tubing. Choose 2-way NC/NO or 3-way function.

functionIntro: The rocker diaphragm opens or closes a connection in a 2-way solenoid valve, or switches the common port between the other two ports in a 3-way solenoid valve. Choose a normally closed or normally open 2-way version for the required state without power. A pump or pressure difference moves the fluid; the valve controls its path.
materialIntro: Choose EPDM, FKM or FFKM diaphragms and matching O-rings for the actual reagent and cleaning fluid. Base-mounted and barbed versions use a PEEK base plate. Threaded versions offer additional valve-seat materials; PFA seat or base-plate configurations require a separate configuration check.
labels: Configuration family (not a complete ordering code)
baseMaterial: PEEK; PFA for threaded versions by configuration
seatMaterial: PVDF / PTFE / PMMA / POM / PEEK; PFA by configuration
testConditions: 25 °C, rated voltage, maximum operating pressure with air, common port pressurized. Response varies with fluid, pressure, tubing and temperature.
applicationsIntro: Use a 2-way solenoid valve to open or close a reagent line, or a 3-way solenoid valve to switch a common line between two fluid connections. Match the SV10 connection style to your manifold, tube fittings or flexible tubing.

applicationItems.title: 2-way solenoid valves for reagent on/off control
paragraphs: In an automated analyzer, a 2-way valve can open the reagent line for a dispensing step and close it afterwards. Choose NC when the connection must be closed without power, or NO when it must remain open.
Coordinate the valve with the pump and equipment program. The valve controls the connection; the pump and its operating sequence determine the amount delivered.

applicationItems.title: 3-way solenoid valves for reagent and wash-fluid switching
paragraphs: A 3-way valve can connect a common line alternately to reagent and cleaning fluid. After the reagent step, switch to the wash connection and use the pump to flush the shared tubing.
Set wash volume and repetitions according to the fluids, tubing length and acceptable residue, and check the result using the actual cleaning cycle.

applicationItems.title: Equipment integration: manifold or tubing connections
paragraphs: Use the base-mounted version when combining valves on a fluidic manifold. Choose threaded connections for tube fittings, or barbed connections for flexible tubing.
Plan access for installation, tubing replacement and wiring. The three connection styles serve different layouts while retaining the same choices of 2-way or 3-way function.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a 2-way and a 3-way solenoid valve?
faqs.answer: A 2-way solenoid valve opens or closes one connection. A 3-way solenoid valve switches a common connection between two other ports, for example reagent and wash fluid. The SV10 series offers both functions in manifold-mounted, threaded and barbed versions.

faqs.question: Should I choose a normally closed or normally open solenoid valve?
faqs.answer: Choose the valve according to what your equipment needs when power is removed. A normally closed solenoid valve closes the connection without power and opens it when energized. A normally open solenoid valve does the reverse. The SV10 series offers NC and NO options for its 2-way valves.

faqs.question: How should I choose diaphragm and valve-seat materials?
faqs.answer: Provide the reagent and cleaning-fluid composition, concentration, temperature and contact time. Check all wetted parts together: diaphragm, O-rings, base plate and, on threaded versions, the valve seat. A material name alone does not establish compatibility with every fluid.

faqs.question: What power-saving options are available?
faqs.answer: Standard power is 2.5 W; the optional power-saving circuit uses 2.5 W at start and no more than 1 W while holding. Observe polarity: red positive, black negative.

faqs.question: How quickly does the valve respond?
faqs.answer: Response is ≤15 ms for the standard version and ≤25 ms with the power-saving circuit under no-load test conditions at 25 °C, rated voltage and maximum operating air pressure applied to the common port. Actual timing varies with the circuit and fluid. FFKM diaphragms respond more slowly at temperatures of 15 °C or below.

faqs.question: What information is needed for a configuration request?
faqs.answer: Send the circuit diagram, 2-way or 3-way requirement, unpowered state, connection type, reagent and cleaning fluids, pressure, temperature and supply voltage. Include mounting space and cycle timing so we can match the connection, materials and power-saving option.

needsText: Describe which liquid must flow at each step and what should happen when power is removed. Include the connection drawing, fluids, pressure, temperature, supply voltage and installation space.
ctaText: Match the valve function, connection, wetted materials and voltage to your equipment.

two.heading: 2-Way Miniature Solenoid Valves
two.definition: FOREACH SV10 2-way miniature solenoid valves use a rocker diaphragm to open or close reagent and wash-fluid lines in automated equipment. Choose normally closed or normally open operation to match the required state without power.
two.operation: A normally closed valve closes the connection without power and opens it when energized. A normally open valve does the reverse. Coordinate the valve with the pump and control program: the valve controls the connection, while a pump or pressure difference moves the fluid.
two.selection: Choose SV10-P for manifold mounting, SV10-M6 or SV10-U28 for threaded fittings, or SV10-B16 for flexible tubing. Select the wetted materials for your fluids.
two.seo: FOREACH SV10 2-way miniature solenoid valves for reagent and wash-fluid on/off control. Normally closed or open; manifold, threaded or barbed connections.
two.applicationTitle: Power-off behavior: normally closed or normally open
two.applicationText: Use a normally closed version when the line must close without power, or normally open when it must remain open. Consider this state as part of the equipment shutdown and restart sequence.
two.faqQuestion: How does a 2-way solenoid valve control flow?

three.heading: 3-Way Miniature Solenoid Valves
three.definition: FOREACH SV10 3-way miniature solenoid valves use a rocker diaphragm to switch a common port between two other ports. They select reagent or wash-fluid connections in automated equipment.
three.operation: Connect the common port to the shared line and the other ports to the two paths to be selected. Coordinate switching with the pump and equipment program. Three ports describe the connection arrangement; they do not mean three simultaneous flows or proportional mixing.
three.selection: Choose SV10-P for manifold mounting, SV10-M6 or SV10-U28 for threaded fittings, or SV10-B16 for flexible tubing. Confirm the common port and energized/de-energized connections, then select wetted materials.
three.seo: FOREACH SV10 3-way miniature solenoid valves for reagent and wash-fluid switching. Compare manifold, threaded and barbed connections and wetted materials.
three.applicationTitle: Connection planning: identify the common port
three.applicationText: Identify the shared line and the two paths to be selected. Check which ports connect with power applied and removed, then coordinate valve switching with the pump sequence.
three.faqQuestion: How does a 3-way solenoid valve switch fluid paths?
